harness.sameSeriesAsPlatinum: electronicsPass is the power+sensors wall-clock (historical performance-*.json named that series detectionPass)

current.note: Current Platinum evidence for 51738ca. Both C2 runs failed electronicsPass 2/4. Sensor baseline also failed p99; cumulative frame increments passed.

performanceJson.note: Older EW tip, not 51738ca. Kept as historical evidence; not current 51738ca results.

supplementaryFollowup.note: 300-sample quieter supplementary host of 51738ca. Not current Platinum authority.

harness.cumulativeFrameGate: whole-frame tick p95 vs pre-sensor baseline <=2ms

percentile.method: nearest-rank floor(n * p) on a sorted copy
percentile.note: Copy is required so raw sample order is kept. Same method as historical 300-sample receipts (those used n = 300). Mean / stdev / min / max are variability, not the gate.

timer.epochApi: Date.now() immediately before const t = performance.now(); not inside the timed deltas
timer.note: Receipts in this family commonly show ~0.1 ms steps (Chromium time resolution). Percentiles use the recorded values as-is.

harness.measurementBoundary: electronicsPass is the unchanged 2/4 full-workload timer. detectionPass, updateMs and whole-frame tick are reported separately and are not substitute gates. SeekerCPU is the full projectile update and stays in whole-frame measurements. --profile is optional and is not the gate.

previousHarness.note: Preserved old helper. This file is the new harness; freeze it only after Fable reviews the diff. Unchanged means measurement boundaries and thresholds, not the entire file.

launch.preloadInjectedFlagsNote: Playwright injects additional Chromium flags that appear in recordedArgv but not extraArgs. Those are preload-injected; they are not extraArgs.

electronicsPass.reason: pre-sensor tree has no power+sensors full-workload timer

detectionPass.reason: pre-sensor tree has no detection pass

seekerCPU.reason: pre-sensor tree has no sensor-pass seeker window

gc.note: acceptance: forced GC is forbidden. No --js-flags=--expose-gc. gc() is never called. Naturally occurring GC stays in the samples. forcedGcThisRun is derived from actual gc() calls, not the diagnostics flag.
